name: Spectacle Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 255120 (140 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on the east shore of Spectacle Lake. Single-family sites. 500-ft sandy swim beach. 17 reservable online / 17 FCFS. --Claude

name: Anvil Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10039857 (133 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on 377-acre Anvil Lake off Hwy 70. 18 sites (13 drive-in RV/tent, 5 walk-in tent); drive-in sites to ~25-40 ft. Hand-pump water, paved roads. 10 reservable online / 8 FCFS. Anvil National Recreation Trail trailhead. --Claude

name: Bear Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251942 (185 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Laona RD) on the SW corner of 66-acre Bear Lake (electric motors only). 27 sites (22 drive-in RV/tent, 5 walk-in tent on a peninsula); most drive-in sites ~25-30 ft. Hand-pump water, swim beach, boat landing. 16 reservable online / 11 FCFS. --Claude

name: Boot Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251274 (188 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Lakewood-Laona RD) on 263-acre Boot Lake. Paved roads; ~21 reservable online + ~12 FCFS. Swim beach, boat landing. Over half the sites fit 30 ft, several back-ins to ~45 ft. --Claude

name: Franklin Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233774 (140 days observed, edges closes)
note: Historic CCC-built Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) campground on Franklin Lake; on the National Register of Historic Places. Single-family sites; ~43 reservable online + ~34 FCFS. Back-ins. Open ~late Apr-mid Oct. --Claude

name: Kentuck Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 255124 (188 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on 955-acre Kentuck Lake. ~18 reservable online + ~13 FCFS. Pressurized drinking water, boat landing. Back-ins. --Claude

name: Lac Vieux Desert Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10238116 (93 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on the west shore of Lac Vieux Desert (Wisconsin River headwaters). Boat landing, picnic shelter, beach. Back-ins. --Claude

name: Wanoka Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10341479 (124 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Washburn RD) on 15-acre Wanoka Lake ~7 mi E of Iron River. Back-ins up to 30/35/45+ ft. Carry-in boat access + small dock. Reservable online (~60% of sites) with remainder FCFS. Open ~May 2-Oct 31. --Claude

name: Namekagon Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233760 (154 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Great Divide RD) alongside 3,227-acre Namekagon Lake ~13 mi E of Cable. 34 sites, many accommodating 45+ ft RVs. Sandy swim beach, boat landing, fishing pier. Reservable online (~20 sites) with FCFS remainder. --Claude

name: Beaver Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233757 (125 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Great Divide RD) on 35-acre Beaver Lake near Mellen. 10 sites (mix RV/tent; sites 2,6,9 tent-only), RV pads ~25-30 ft posted back-in with ~40-ft aprons. Boat launch ~0.5 mi away. Sites 4,5,6,7,9,10 reservable online; 1,2,3,8 FCFS. --Claude
